title: LifeTox: Unveiling Implicit Toxicity in Life Advice

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models' ability to classify open-ended, real-life advice as safe or unsafe (unethical, manipulative, or socially harmful) using zero-shot inference and fine-tuning on the LifeTox dataset, as well as out-of-domain safety benchmarks like HarmfulQ, BeaverTails, and HHH Alignment.
